response.sql: SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg_length) AS average_rating_length, AVG(per_rating_avg_ratio) AS average_rating_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS per_rating_avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS per_rating_avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating
